title: Not So Dismal Science
summary:
Not So Dismal Science
With the latest release of economic indicators, some economists are hinting that the United States could be headed for weaker times. Thanks to continued consumer spending, the US economy, among others, has been chugging along at relatively strong levels despite sustained high energy prices. However, cynics are beginning to ask, "Is this the beginning of the end?" While most data is subject to interpretation, the public's perception about the health of the economy is certainly changing.

children.title: Keep Working
children.summary: At this point, the unemployment rate in America is at 4.5%, remaining within the lower end of the traditional "comfort" range of between 4-6%. If unemployment continues at manageable levels, then consumer spending and economic growth can continue.

children.title: The Price of Energy
children.summary: One interesting finding by the Conference Board is the decline in the proportion of people that plan to buy a home. It is suggested that high fuel prices are deferring many big ticket purchases in households - and apparently houses themselves.
